headline: 1 Cash-Heavy Stock with Exciting Potential and 2 We Question
summary: A cash-heavy balance sheet is often a sign of strength, but not always. Some companies avoid debt because they have weak business models, limited expansion opportunities, or inconsistent cash flow.

headline: CoStar Data Shows London Dominates UK Office Development as Regional Pipeline Hits 20-Year Low
summary: LONDON, July 31, 2026--Office construction in UK regions has fallen to its lowest level in at least 20 years, according to data from CoStar, a global leading provider of online real estate marketplaces, information and analytics in the property markets.
